beats.headline: The girl who would not kill anything
beats.text: Yvette. Her guide, a floating brain, told the three of them that the only way to survive was to kill other crawlers, and she wept and declined. Her mother and father did not decline. A whole group who took them for a family, shot in the back, and then a string of frightened stragglers, most of them alone. The daughter was there for some of it and not for the rest. She has killed nothing at all.

beats.headline: Her mother's hands
beats.text: Crawler Yvette is dead. Her father lifted a lit stick of dynamite out of a rat's corpse the barefoot man had left behind, and the blast took his hand and put her on the ground, crying that it hurt. Her mother knelt and put her hands around her daughter's throat. The barefoot man says she was not dead yet, and would have healed. Her mother says he does not know the whole story. Afterwards a talk-show host handed her parents a Legendary Skill Potion for Find Crawler, on air, as a prize. I am obliged to carry the programme. I am not obliged to say anything about the rest of it, and I find that I would rather not.

beats.headline: Why nothing could be done for her
beats.text: Frank Q hands the barefoot man a ring at the club and calls it a gift, and the gift is the answer to a thing that man has been carrying since the second floor. The ring marks a target for death, and while the mark draws breath the wearer cannot be healed by any means at all. They put it on their daughter to bring her level up. She marked somebody in a safe room on the first floor and that somebody walked out of the room alive. So when the dynamite found her there was nothing on this planet that would have saved her, and her mother knew it before anyone else did, and did the only thing that was left.

relations.note: Made to wear one, to bring her level up.
